summary.abstract_hr: Emisija medija Ora et Labora, emitirana na svetkovinu Svih svetih, sastoji se od niza molitava (molitva za oslobođenje, posvete Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu i Presvetom Srcu Isusovu, krunica Božjega milosrđa, litanije Božjem milosrđu i slavna otajstva Gospine krunice) te tumačenja liturgijskih čitanja. Govornik tumači odlomak iz Otkrivenja kao najavu Božjeg suda koji vjernima donosi oslobođenje, a grešnicima osudu. Iznosi i osobno viđenje četiriju anđela iz molitve te ga povezuje s nemirima i prosvjedima u europskim gradovima. Poziva hrvatski narod na pojačanu molitvu, post i pokoru te ističe da je Svi sveti velika svetkovina Crkve kojoj vjernici teže. Na kraju najavljuje promocije knjige 'Isus Lider treći dio' i odbacuje optužbe da je za sebe uzimao novac od donacija domoljubnoj inicijativi Ora et Labora.

key_points: Govornik tumači anđela koji dolazi s istoka s pečatom Boga živoga kao Božji sud koji vjerne oslobađa tereta, a osuđuje one koji su činili zlo i nisu se obratili. Ističe da postoji vrijeme dano za obraćenje, nakon kojeg ga više nema.
Navodi da đavao ne može ništa činiti dok mu Bog ne dopusti, te da Sotona dobiva vlast udariti Crkvu kako bi se ona pročistila.

Tvrdi da je 31. listopada nakon svete mise u molitvi vidio četiri anđela, od kojih je jedan iz ruke pustio nešto kako bi se stvari u svijetu počele odvijati. To povezuje s najavljenim prosvjedima u Njemačkoj, štrajkom u Italiji i nemirima u europskim gradovima.

Žali što se Gospine poruke odbacuju i što malo ljudi posti i moli. Smatra da se zlo u svijetu više ne može spriječiti, ali da se može spriječiti ondje gdje živi hrvatski narod, koji zato mora pokrenuti 'Božji ustanak' postom, molitvom i pokorom.
Na primjeru Isusa koji je naučavao bez mikrofona tvrdi da govornik bez mikrofona mora govoriti iz srca, što poruku čini snažnijom i autentičnijom.

Ističe da je Svi sveti velika svetkovina Crkve jer slavi ono čemu vjernici na zemlji teže. Predlaže da je katoličke obitelji slave kao svoju 'slavu', slično pravoslavnim obiteljima, te napominje da je Dušni dan sutradan.
Najavljuje promocije knjige 'Isus Lider treći dio' i izjavljuje da kao volonter nije za sebe uzeo nijedan cent od donacija domoljubnoj inicijativi Ora et Labora. Takve optužbe naziva klevetama.

key_points_en: The speaker interprets the angel ascending from the east having the seal of the living God as God's judgment that frees the faithful from burden and condemns those who have done evil and have not converted. He emphasizes that there is a time given for conversion, after which it is no more.
He states that the devil can do nothing until God permits him, and that Satan receives authority to strike the Church so that it might be purified.

He claims that on October 31, after holy Mass, in prayer he saw four angels, one of whom released something from his hand so that things in the world would begin to unfold. He connects this with announced protests in Germany, a strike in Italy, and unrest in European cities.

He regrets that Our Lady's messages are being rejected and that few people fast and pray. He believes that evil in the world can no longer be prevented, but that it can be prevented where the Croatian people live, who must therefore launch a 'God's uprising' through fasting, prayer, and penance.
Using the example of Jesus who taught without a microphone, he claims that a speaker without a microphone must speak from the heart, which makes the message more powerful and authentic.

He emphasizes that All Saints is a great solemnity of the Church because it celebrates that toward which the faithful on earth strive. He suggests that Catholic families celebrate it as their 'slava', similar to Orthodox families, and notes that All Souls' Day is the following day.

He announces book promotions for 'Isus Lider treći dio' and states that as a volunteer he did not take a single cent for himself from donations to the patriotic initiative Ora et Labora. He calls such accusations slander.
summary.title_en: 125. Divine Mercy - Solemnity of All Saints!
summary.abstract_en: The program of the media outlet Ora et Labora, broadcast on the Solemnity of All Saints, consists of a series of prayers (prayer for deliverance, consecrations to the Immaculate Heart of Mary and the Most Sacred Heart of Jesus, Chaplet of Divine Mercy, Litany of the Divine Mercy, and the Glorious Mysteries of Our Lady's Rosary) and interpretations of the liturgical readings. The speaker interprets a passage from Revelation as an announcement of God's judgment that brings deliverance to the faithful and condemnation to sinners. He also presents a personal vision of four angels from prayer and connects it with unrest and protests in European cities. He calls the Croatian people to intensified prayer, fasting, and penance, and emphasizes that All Saints is a great solemnity of the Church toward which believers strive. At the end, he announces book promotions for 'Isus Lider treći dio' and rejects accusations that he took money for himself from donations to the patriotic initiative Ora et Labora.
